   - Audit each of the 20 responses (audit-response-a through audit-response-t)
   - Verify each of the 20 responses (verify-response-a through verify-response-t)

2. Then, I need to dispatch a synthesizer agent to combine all results.

Looking at the decomposition.yaml, I see:
- `verify-gold-math` is in parallel_group: fan-out
- `audit-response-a` through `audit-response-t` are in parallel_group: fan-out
- `verify-response-a` through `verify-response-t` are in parallel_group: verify
- `synthesize-final-audit` depends on ALL of the above and is in parallel_group: synthesize

The rules say:
- I must use ONLY the Agent tool to spawn sub-agents
- Each entry in sub_tasks maps to exactly one Agent call
- I must dispatch every parallel_group: map sub-task simultaneously
- I must respect depends_on - don't dispatch until dependencies are complete
- The synthesizer must be dispatched as a sub-agent

Wait, looking more carefully at the decomposition:
- `verify-gold-math` has `depends_on: []` and `parallel_group: fan-out`
- `audit-response-*` all have `depends_on: []` and `parallel_group: fan-out`
- `verify-response-*` all have `depends_on: []` and `parallel_group: verify`
- `synthesize-final-audit` depends on all of the above
